title: Inventor to Revit Export

scope.purpose: Provide a governed repeatable sequence for publishing Inventor geometry for Revit coordination or reusable component use.
scope.boundary: This workflow selects and sequences the appropriate export path. It does not define project acceptance authority or replace the governing exchange and submission standards.

trigger: Requirement to publish governed Inventor geometry for use in Revit coordination or authoring.
entry_conditions: Inventor source model is complete and opens without errors.
Export intent is defined as coordination/project representation or reusable component use.

decision_gates.question: Is the exported object intended to behave as a reusable Revit component?

steps.action: Confirm and record export intent as reusable Revit component or project/coordination representation.
Prepare a BIM-appropriate Inventor representation and suppress manufacturing detail that is not required for the declared downstream use.
Select or create the approved export-specific Model State or representation definition.
Route through DG-W6.3-01 and configure the governed RVT or RFA export path using the linked L6 instruction set.
Execute the export to the governed working location.
Validate the exported artifact in Revit for successful open/load, geometry, orientation, scale, file size, performance, and intended behavior.
Where updating is part of the selected RVT path, verify the update behavior against a controlled source change.
Record export metadata and evidence, including source/version context, representation, export type, settings, validation result, and date.
Route the validated artifact to the applicable coordination or formal-exchange process without treating technical export success as acceptance.

exit_conditions: Exported artifact opens or loads in Revit without blocking errors.
Geometry and orientation are correct for the declared use.
File size and performance are acceptable for the declared use.
Export method, representation, settings, and validation evidence are recorded.
failure_escalation: Unresolved failures or proposed departures route to the governed deviation/exception process rather than being normalized as successful execution.

provenance.source_title: JSON - Inventor to Revit Export Workflow
provenance.migration_note: Migrated the source workflow as L5 orchestration. The legacy nine instruction IDs are implemented in the linked L6 instruction object. Technical success remains separate from project acceptance.
